promotions.body:
## Cadance 7
One search for your library and Apple Music, plus an all-new Visual Tour.

- **Search**: the magnifier in the header finds your media, Syllabus, playlists, and Apple Music together
- **Visual Tour**: rebuilt for Cadance 7 with Quick Start, Passes and Modes, and Troubleshooting
- **Account & Passes**: subscription, Day Passes, Practice Passes, and purchase history in one Settings section

Open the Visual Tour in Favorites for a guided walkthrough. Not on Cadance 7 yet? Update in the App Store.

## Save 33% - Full access
Passes cost up to **33%** less, and Artist subscribers now have full access.

Day Passes and Practice Passes now offer savings of up to 33%.

Every Artist subscriber has full access to features and Apple Music for the price you already pay. The Patron tier has been retired.

Nothing to do. Your expanded access is already active.

## Perfect Practice Pass
Unlock one eligible track for 30 days, ideal for an exercise you repeat often.

Choose the track you teach with most. A Perfect Practice Pass unlocks it for 30 days, however often you play it.

## Separate from Day Passes
A Day Pass unlocks Cadance for the teaching day. A Perfect Practice Pass unlocks one selected track for 30 days.

Find Perfect Practice Passes in Settings or in an eligible track's action menu.

## Teach with a Day Pass
Full access until midnight on the days you teach. Day Passes never expire.

In Class Planning mode, every track starts with a 15-second planning preview. When it is time to teach, activate a Day Pass for full access until midnight.

Activate a Day Pass from Settings > Day Passes while Preview Mode is active, or from an eligible track's action menu. Day Passes never expire, so you use them only on the days you teach.
